messages:
marco: alert from our log monitor: backup-sync printed a KMS resource path + truncated ciphertext in staging logs. no plaintext but treat as sensitive.

elaine: paste the exact line and which pod/job?

marco: redacted snippet:
```
WARN backup-sync: unwrap error projects/retail-2/locations/global/keyRings/backup-ring/cryptoKeys/transit-bak: ciphertext=Rw7k...2Lm
```
job: backup-sync-2026-04-06-09.

nish: OK assume potential leak. immediate checklist: 1) preserve audit (KMS/IAM/GCS) 2) revoke decrypt for backup SA in staging, 3) rotate the KMS key, 4) identify affected objects and owners, 5) scrub logs and deploy redaction.

marco: running quick grep: `kubectl -n staging logs -l app=backup-sync --since=4h | grep "unwrap error"` -> 4 hits from backup-sync-1 on node stg-7. partner webhook called after one failure, tagging @nish for partner egress check.

nish: pinged partner eng. will confirm if they received any blobs. meanwhile applying RBAC removal for backup-sa in staging:
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding retail-2 \\
  --member=serviceAccount:backup-sa@retail-2.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

oncall: Ack. will snapshot 72h of Cloud Audit Logs (KMS/IAM/GCS) and export to gs://sec-preserve/inc-3654321000/ then DM link.

vault-bot: Received transit rotation request for projects/retail-2/locations/global/keyRings/backup-ring/cryptoKeys/transit-bak. Rotation queued. ref=rot-3654.

elaine: marco please list objects that reference old ciphertext header in backup metadata. we'll contact owners with rewrap instructions.

marco: found ~10 objects in gs://backups/staging/2026-04-06/* whose metadata header references the old wrapped blob prefix. owners = team-storage, analytics-backup, partner-ingest.

nish: applied RBAC removal (terraform diff: -1 binding). also creating temporary IAM condition to block calls from the backup job's service account from outside the cluster as extra protection.

oncall: audit export started -> gs://sec-preserve/inc-3654321000/audit-export.tar.gz. will DM when complete.

vault-bot: Rotation complete. New primary version: 8. Audit entries: gs://sec-preserve/inc-3654321000/rotation.log.

elaine: owners will get a 48h window to rewrap. include script in the ticket and a verification checklist. sample rewrap script: 
```
NEWVER=projects/retail-2/locations/global/keyRings/backup-ring/cryptoKeys/transit-bak/cryptoKeyVersions/8
for o in $(gsutil ls gs://backups/staging/2026-04-06/*); do
  python tools/rewrap_backup.py --object "$o" --new-key "$NEWVER"
done
```

marco: partner replied: they only got a status callback; no downloads. owners notified via INC-2026-0623-01.

nish: pushing logging fix to redact KMS resource names: regex replace `projects/.*/keyRings/.*/cryptoKeys/[^:\s]+` -> `<kms_redacted>` in backup-sync. small patch linked in the incident. will also add an alert rule for 48h scanning for KMS patterns and page on hits.

oncall: audit export complete -> gs://sec-preserve/inc-3654321000/audit-export.tar.gz (attached to ticket).

elaine: follow-ups: 1) run retro log-scrub for indexed logs if retention allows, 2) add runbook addendum for "KMS resource path logged" with exact checklist (RBAC revoke, audit export, transit rotate, owner rewrap, double rotate, log scrub, comms template), 3) schedule 30m postmortem tomorrow.

nish: will rotate again after owner rewrap window and then restore least-privilege roles. also adding a short-lived deny policy on vault to block backup-sa from unwrapping during the window.

marco: summary: detection -> RBAC lockdown -> audit preservation -> transit rotation -> owner rewrap window -> logging redact & alerts -> second rotation -> restore. tracking INC-2026-0623-01. :white_check_mark:
